f048bda5-391d-4d83-a910-9d190fbe93d0.role_description:
Job Title: Full Stack Web Developer (Fresher / Intern)
Company: SPS Partners
Location: Remote / On-site
Experience: 0–2 Years
Employment Type: Full-time / Internship
🧾 Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated Full Stack Web Developer to join our growing team. The candidate will work on real-time web and AI-based projects, collaborate with team members, and contribute to building scalable and user-friendly applications.

🔧 Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain web applications

Work with frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React

Develop backend logic using Node.js / Java / Python

Integrate APIs and manage databases (JSON / Firebase / MongoDB)

Debug, test, and optimize applications

Collaborate with designers and project coordinators

Prepare basic documentation and reports for projects

🎓 Required Skills

Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Familiarity with React / Angular / Vue (any one)

Understanding of backend concepts

Basic database knowledge (JSON / MySQL / Firebase)

Problem-solving and logical thinking

Willingness to learn new technologies
